analysis.title: Baker Hughes Co. (BKR): 3Q26 First Take: EBITDA and Orders Beat; Raised IET Horizon 2 Order Guide to $50+ bil
key_insights: BKR reported 3Q26 EBITDA of $1,415 mil, 5% above GS estimate of $1,347 mil and FactSet consensus of $1,344 mil. Revenue was $8,025 mil, 4% above GS.
Segment revenue beat GS: Industrial and Energy Technology (IET) +4%, Oilfield Services and Equipment (OFSE) +3%, Chart +9%.
Segment EBITDA margins vs GS: IET 19.7% (-17 bps), OFSE 18.0% (+39 bps), Chart 17.6% (+228 bps).
Total orders were $10,764 mil in 3Q26 versus GS estimate of $7,014 mil, with strength across the portfolio. IET orders were $5,886 mil, OFSE $4,047 mil and Chart $831 mil.
Backlog is $46.4 bil: IET $39.4 bil, OFSE $3.4 bil, Chart $3.6 bil.
Management raised the 2026-2028 IET Horizon 2 order guide from $45+ bil to $50+ bil, and raised the FY26 IET orders guide to $21.5-23.5 bil (midpoint $22.5 bil).
Free cash flow in the quarter was $769 mn.

FY26 guidance was slightly raised at the midpoint, with key assumptions around disruptions in the Middle East. Revenue guide is $29.16-30.06 bil (midpoint $29.61 bil vs GS $29.49 bil, consensus $29.51 bil) and adjusted EBITDA guide is $5.13-5.40 bil (midpoint $5.295 bil vs GS $5.29 bil, consensus $5.21 bil).

4Q26 consolidated guidance is below GS on both lines: revenue midpoint $8.25 bil vs GS $8.45 bil and consensus $8.34 bil, and adjusted EBITDA midpoint $1.460 bil vs GS $1.56 bil and consensus $1.47 bil.

4Q26 segment guidance midpoints vs GS: OFSE revenue $3.60 bil (GS $3.67 bil) and EBITDA $640 mil (GS $641 mil); IET revenue $3.55 bil (GS $3.59 bil) and EBITDA $715 mil (GS $717 mil); Chart revenue $1.10 bil (GS $1.195 bn) and EBITDA $195 mn (GS $216 mn).

Adjusted EPS of $0.70 was above GS $0.59. The gap came mostly from below-the-line items: a 2.2% tax rate against GS 26.0%, other income of $337 mil against GS -$5 mil, and net interest expense of $177 mil against GS $200 mil.
Buy rating, 12-month price target $71 (price $59.00, 20.3% upside). The target averages an 11.0x through-cycle EV/EBITDA multiple and a 5.5% through-cycle free cash flow yield.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Buy and a $71 target after the 3Q26 EBITDA and orders beat. The IET Horizon 2 order guide was raised to $50+ bil. The target was last set 29-Sep-26.
